Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
---------
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Pramod Kumar, Advocate
For the State : Mr. N. K. Gaunjhu, A.P.P
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant, who is in custody since 13.11.2022, has renewed the prayer for grant of regular bail in connection with S.T. No.183 of 2023, arising out of Pratappur P.S. Case No.149 of 2022,
corresponding to G.R. No.256 of 2023.
3. It appears that this applicant has been made an accused for committing the offence under Sections 341/ 323/ 457/ 376/ 511 of the Indian Penal Code.

Earlier, the bail application of this applicant was rejected vide order dated 17.02.2023, passed in B.A. No.650 of 2023.
4.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that complete set of F.I.R along with its enclosures have been annexed with the present bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the Mantu Bharti @ Mantu Kumar vs The State Of Jharkhand .....

1 trial.
It has been submitted that the charge has already been framed.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
5. Learned A.P.P has opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the above facts and the period of custody, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to be released on bail, on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned District & 3 rd Additional Sessions Judge, Chatra in connection with S.T. No.183 of 2023, arising out of Pratappur P.S. Case No.149 of 2022, corresponding to G.R. No.256 of 2023, subject to the condition that the applicant will submit self- attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
